sql:
SELECT t.name AS tenant_name,
  COUNT(*) AS customers,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cust.before_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_with_session_before,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cust.after_cnt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS pct_with_session_after,
  ROUND(AVG(cust.after_cnt), 2) AS avg_sessions_after_first_order_per_customer
FROM (
  SELECT fo.tenant_id, fo.user_id, fo.first_order_at,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_sessions ws WHERE ws.tenant_id = fo.tenant_id AND ws.user_id = fo.user_id AND ws.started_at <= fo.first_order_at) AS before_cnt,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM web_sessions ws WHERE ws.tenant_id = fo.tenant_id AND ws.user_id = fo.user_id AND ws.started_at > fo.first_order_at) AS after_cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT tenant_id, user_id, MIN(placed_at) AS first_order_at
    FROM orders
    WHERE tenant_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenants WHERE name IN ('Brennquell Kaffee','Spice Route Box','Grind Collective','Honeycomb Larder'))
    GROUP BY tenant_id, user_id
  ) fo
) cust
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = cust.tenant_id
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY t.name
note: Customers are distinct (tenant_id,user_id) pairs from orders (any status) per tenant; web_sessions are matched by tenant_id+user_id (anonymous pre-login sessions without a user_id are not linked to a customer and so can't be counted as 'before' browsing for them). All 4 named subscription tenants are included by name match against tenants.
